meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先派子代理查文档与现有示例,再产出一份分阶段的实施计划,每个阶段都带文档引用、验证清单和要避开的反面写法。
howto.when: 当你要求规划某个功能、任务或多步骤实现时接管,尤其是在用 do 执行之前。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude gathers docs via subagents, then writes a phased implementation plan runnable in new chat contexts, each phase with doc references, a verification checklist and anti-pattern guards.
